title: senna huancabambae
intro: Senna huancabambae, commonly known as the yellow senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is a shrub that has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Senna huancabambae include its ability to act as a laxative, due to its anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting digestion and relieving symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome.
